name: Eighteen Clans of the Spirit Realm

pages.text: spirit_realm_clan_quests.json provides two quest hooks for each of the eighteen Spirit Realm clans, encountered through pilgrimage and regional events.
pages.title: Eighteen Spirit Realm Clans

pages.text: The pilgrimage route is spirit_eighteen_pilgrimage. Clan relations and affinity with the Demon Kings of the Wilds can alter events and trade; see barbarian_faction_affinity_map.
pages.title: Pilgrimage and Affinity
